text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is feeling under the<n>weather, so I
send her to the<n>infirmary to rest.
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard. Just rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm not pushing myself... Anyway,<n>later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about this... I'll try to recover as<n>soon as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Where am I? Wait a second...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Where am I? Wait a second...

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
Is it true that you got a modeling<n>contract and
you're moving abroad?!

text_block_list.name: Crush
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But I can't stand to be away<n>from you!
Won't you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's happening?! Those two<n>are from the
manga I drew!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist races in the Twinkle<n>Series, but an
upperclassman she<n>admires who's a popular
model<n>invites her to move abroad...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't decide whether she should<n>chase after
her love or her dream, so<n>I just stopped writing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder how things pan out for the<n>two of them.

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to be apart from you<n>either. But I also
can't give up my<n>dream of reaching the top of the
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
I'll run so well in my races that you'll<n>see me on TV
and online every day,<n>no matter where in the world
you are!

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
And I want to see you too, so work<n>hard and make
it big! Then, one day,<n>you'll come back for me,
won't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Crush
text_block_list.text: So that's your answer.

text_block_list.name: Crush
text_block_list.text:
All right... We'll be together even<n>though we're
apart! Let's both<n>achieve our dreams!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wah?! W-was that a dream?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So that's what happens... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Good luck, you two... I'll do my best<n>too.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems Mejiro Dober is able to fully<n>recover from
her exhaustion and<n>returns to her normal self.

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
So I'll destroy this world for tearing<n>the two of us
apart!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?!

I can't believe it... My selfishness in<n>wanting to
keep you close to me has<n>turned you into an evil
queen!

text_block_list.name: Crush
text_block_list.text:
This is my doing... As the hero, I'll<n>take you down
myself!

text_block_list.name: Protagonist
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... I won't let that happen.<n>You'll be living
with me in the world<n>I'll create for just the two of
us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Agh! Stop! This makes no sense!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wah?! W-was that a dream?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Thank goodness that wasn't<n>real... Worst plot
twist I've ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is so shaken that she<n>doesn't get
any meaningful rest,<n>mentally or physically.
